svg.text: The R13 admission machine — one machine, both perception sources
not_tracked means absent from the store, not an entry flagged not_tracked. A drop erases the entry.
not_tracked
absent from the store
tentative
in the store, confirming
tracked
published to the assessment
What one update is
relayed VehicleC — one relayed object message, and the range it reports
own-sensor VehicleB — one detector line, and the range it estimates
The two sources run at independently configured cadences, which is why
the machine is parameterized only by what counts as an update.
Why the timeout is a time and not a count
The requirement's own wording is that a track's messages stop, and a counter
cannot express silence — nothing arrives to increment it. One count across two
cadences would also mean two different real timeouts, so retuning another
node's rate would silently change this node's behaviour.
It is measured on a monotonic stamp the store keeps beside each entry, so a
host clock step cannot expire every track at once.
tentative edges
tracked edges
update within the enter gate
create the entry, hits = 1
hits reach the confirm count
update within the enter gate — hits + 1
update within the exit gate — refresh
update beyond the enter gate — erase, hits = 0
silence past the timeout — erase, hits = 0
update beyond the exit gate — the hysteresis drop
silence past the timeout — erase, hits = 0
